basis: EFS v1 section5.1 describes pooling three search trajectories and re-evaluation; exact author implementation unavailable.
primary_rule: Union all accepted factors, deduplicate exact source-code hashes, gate by earliest discovery close across the three declared runs. Each day re-rank every causally available member using the unchanged trailing-feedback engine and source-family latest/best rule. Previously pruned members can re-enter this pooled-library evaluation. No cross-backend or return-selected pooling.
diagnostic_rule: Identical evaluator on the final union with discovery gate disabled, explicitly labelled retrospective hindsight diagnostic. It is never tradable or confirmatory evidence.
clock: Signal at close t, execute close t+1, first earn close t+1 to t+2.
claim_limits: Conditional re-evaluation of previously generated candidate libraries, not a new pool-feedback search policy
